spans.s: Utpalāvana, a tīrtha. § 377 (Dhaumyatīrthak.): III, 87, 8311 (in the east in the country of the Pāñcālas, there Viśvāmitra performed sacrifices).--§ 733o (Gaṅgāhrada): XIII, 25, 1720.
Utpalinī, a river. § 249 (Arjunavanavāsap.): I, 215, 7817 (nadīṃ, visited by Arjuna on his tīrthayātrā).

Utpātaka, a tīrtha. § 733r (Ānuśāsanik.): By bathing in U. [and]
in Ashṭārakra and offering oblations to the pitṛs, and for twelve days abstaining from food one obtains to the merit of a horse-sacrifice: XIII, 25, 1727.
